originalLocatorConvention: Original JSON indexes are zero-based data-record indexes; MAIN checked original raw hashes, physical end lines and all supplied witness fields.

caveats.detail: Recommendations establish historical sampled occurrence only. They do not establish current persistence, establishment, abundance, countywide prevalence, absence, non-detection, or protocol completion. Original source dates span 2007-08-02 through 2013-07-22.
Witnesses were independently selected from the original Kansas ZIP/CSV and national Station CSV. The preliminary candidate diagnostic was not used as review evidence.

All 34 records explicitly report exact Cyprinus carpio, Biological media, Fish/Nekton assemblage, Population Census intent, Count/count, Final status, Actual value type, and a positive finite value. All report Backpack Electroshock equipment. They are species counts, not chemical concentrations, percentages, diversity metrics, or Frequency Class counts.

All 34 records have blank toxicity-test, unidentified-taxon, detection-condition, measure-qualifier, tissue-anatomy, laboratory, analytical-method, and frequency-class fields. No source comment indicates captive or experimentally introduced organisms, failed capture, or counts referring to another species. No length, weight, composite-sample, or provisional-status extension is needed for this Kansas scope.

The 33 NARS records use Fish Abundance Samp / NCA Standard Fish Sample with generic otter-trawl prose, despite Backpack Electroshock equipment and NRSA river/stream project identities. Preserve these source fields and the equipment ambiguity. The actual species count and field collection identity support occurrence; the generic prose does not prove precise gear, trawl duration, replicate count, or historical protocol execution.

Selected EPA_R7_WQX row0 reports Field Msr/Obs, project URBSTM, method R7UAA1 / UAA Quality Assurance Project Plan, Backpack Electroshock, and one common carp on 2007-08-02. Its Blue River 3 Station explicitly assigns Kansas county091. This independent field observation supports the pair without relying on the two NARS Kansas River boundary records. The specific UAA plan revision was not separately retrieved.

All 34 Result records join to exactly one original national Station using OrganizationIdentifier plus MonitoringLocationIdentifier. Each Station is River/Stream, CountryCode US, StateCode20, and an exact leased county. No county was reassigned from coordinates.

All 34 activity coordinate pairs numerically equal their joined Station coordinates. The EPA Region7 Station reports WGS84; the NARS Stations report NAD83. Generalized topology is diagnostic and does not independently verify precise water jurisdiction.

The sole leased Jefferson County witness is NARS_WQX-FW08KS055, Kansas River, 2009-05-27, Count11. Activity and Station coordinates are both longitude-95.49074362, latitude39.05435221; the Station explicitly assigns State20/County087. Generalized Census topology diagnoses county20045 approximately303m across the declared county polygon. This is a near-boundary river discrepancy at approximately the longitude quantization scale of this generalized topology, not a basis to silently reassign the source. Recommend publisher-declared county occurrence with this explicit caveat under the existing publisher-FIPS policy. Precise collection-side or water-jurisdiction verification remains unresolved.

NARS Result25 / Station2995 and Result32 / Station3445 explicitly assign county20091 but diagnose approximately170m and169m into20209 on the generalized Kansas River boundary. These were not selected as primary witnesses because independent EPA_R7 Result0 supports the same pair within its declared county.

Some source comments mention fewer than20 channel widths, fewer than500m of reach, or fewer than500 individuals. These describe sampling effort or adequacy and do not negate an explicitly positive species count. In particular, Result15 reports Count1 with NO-<500 M REACH,<500 INDIV; independent 2013 Result29 was selected for the same pair. No adequacy comment creates a negative determination.

All source dates are valid ISO dates before the review date. Every NARS ActivityIdentifier embeds the same date as ActivityStartDate. EPA_R7 activity BlueRiv3Fish07 agrees with the reported2007 year. No conflicting source date was found.

Repeated visits and alternative station identifiers do not create additional county determinations. BiologicalIndividualIdentifier is blank throughout; do not reinterpret these data as an independently verified count of unique individual fish across records.

The retained Kansas response is complete for its exact state/taxon/Biological/selected-characteristic query: provider headers and independent decoding agree on34 results,34 activities,33 sites. This restricted response is not an exhaustive current county inventory. Missing records or differences from the broader national Station scope create no absence conclusion.

Attribute Water Quality Portal and the exact contributing publishers: EPA National Aquatic Resources Survey (NARS) and EPA R7. Retain original query URLs, retrieval receipts, dates, site identities, and raw record hashes. Public factual evidence is attributed; no blanket CC0 license, endorsement, or universal reuse permission is claimed.

resultFields.SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: Fish and Ephibenthic Invertebrate Collection Fish trawls were conducted at each site to collect fish/shellfish for community structure and abundance estimates, target species for contaminant analyses, and specimens for histopathological examination. Trawls were conducted by using a 16-ft otter trawl and the duration of the trawl will be for 10±2 minutes; replicate (two) trawls will be performed. In open water, the trawl should be conducted in a straight line with the site location near center. The speed over bottom should be approximately 3-4 knots.
